description:
The site's Google Search Console (get_workspace says whether it's connected).
view:
- metrics(rangeDays?): Clicks, impressions, CTR and position against the period before, by day, top searches and pages, countries and devices, from the daily sync (28 days when not given). The newest days are provisional.
- query(dimensions?, days?, startDate?, endDate?, country?, device?, page?, query?, filters?, searchType?, limit?, startRow?, live?): Search Analytics by query, page, country (usa, gbr, deu), device, date or appearance, filtered, up to 1,000 rows (startRow for more). live asks Google now.
- detail(page?, query?): One page's searches against the 28 days before, the site's pages Google shows for one search (several compete), or with neither the searches at positions 8 to 20.
- export(days?, startDate?, endDate?, limit?, startRow?): Every page and search pair, up to 5,000 rows per call (nextStartRow).
- sitemaps: The sitemaps submitted, live: when Google read each, URLs, errors.
- searches(limit?, months?): The site's own searches over 28 days, each with its position, volume, difficulty and Opportunity. Positions 8 to 20 are the nearest wins.
name: get_search_console
title: Get Search Console
